text.en:
Today you learn to say when something happens.
I start at seven.
It means: seven o'clock is my start time.
We meet on Tuesday.
It means: Tuesday is our day.

Put a small word before the time.
For the hour, say at: at seven, at noon.
For the day, say on: on Monday.
For a month or season, say in: in July, in winter.
The gate opens at half past six.
The market opens on Saturdays.
The days are short in winter.

You will pick the small word for each time.
Hour: at. Day: on. Month or season: in.
With every and tonight, use no small word.
I work every Monday.
The film starts tonight.
